# ACE Overall Goal & Active Research Directive

## Overall North-Star Goal (Continuous)
Continuously engineer an **overall better-performing, more cost-effective, and lower-latency ACE cognitive architecture** — optimizing **Cost-of-Pass**, **KV prefix cache hit rate ($\ge 95\%$)**, **uncached token burn**, **turns per task ($\le 2.5$)**, and **$p_{50}/p_{95}$ execution latency** against versioned real-world benchmark suites in `/workspace/benchmarks/`. Inside `bwrap` (`--unshare-all --share-net`), outbound HTTPS and localhost (`http://127.0.0.1:8091/gate`) network access are enabled while host filesystems (`/home`) remain kernel-isolated.
